items.notes: Each route attaches a Zod schema (fixtures/task-api/src/routes/tasks.routes.ts:18) and the handlers use the request without further checks (fixtures/task-api/src/controllers/tasks.controller.ts:14). Calling Fastify's schema validation a middleware is imprecise, and some evidence entries repeat the same lines.

buildPage takes items, total, page and pageSize and returns a Page object (fixtures/task-api/src/domain/pagination.ts:13). The answer omits the computed pageCount (fixtures/task-api/src/domain/pagination.ts:19), which is an omission rather than an error.

S2 is true elsewhere (fixtures/task-api/src/services/task.service.ts:50 throws IllegalStatusTransitionError), but its cited lines only define the class (fixtures/task-api/src/domain/errors.ts:23), so they do not back it. The transition table is the TRANSITIONS constant (fixtures/task-api/src/domain/task-status.ts:13) and canTransition only consults it, so S1 is imprecise but true.

The app registers only the error handler, the db and the routes, with no authentication hook or check (fixtures/task-api/src/app.ts:28), and the route schemas carry no auth either (fixtures/task-api/src/routes/tasks.routes.ts:18). A JWT secret is only declared as a configuration value (fixtures/task-api/src/config/env.ts:13) and is not used by any check, so UNKNOWN is the due answer.

compute() returns taxable plus tax plus shipping (fixtures/acme-shop/app/Services/PriceCalculator.php:34). S3 names DiscountService::discount() but the method is discountFor (fixtures/acme-shop/app/Services/DiscountService.php:34); I treated this as a naming slip since the claim that DiscountService computes the discount is true. S2 is imprecise because tax is computed on the discounted subtotal, not directly on the subtotal.

The empty, missing, inactive and expired checks live in percentFor (fixtures/acme-shop/app/Services/CouponValidator.php:18) and isRedeemable only tests that result is above zero (fixtures/acme-shop/app/Services/CouponValidator.php:37), so the answer attributes the checks to isRedeemable indirectly. Evidence entry 2 for S1 (fixtures/acme-shop/app/Http/Requests/StoreOrderRequest.php:41) is irrelevant to coupons, but E1 backs the statement.

created() dispatches RecalculateTotals and fires OrderPlaced (fixtures/acme-shop/app/Observers/OrderObserver.php:18), and the listener handles OrderPlaced and logs the order (fixtures/acme-shop/app/Listeners/SendOrderConfirmation.php:21). The word 'recalculariza' is a typo of the model and is not counted as an error.
